verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's marketing docs say Pipelines offers deployment environments with centralized visibility, environment-level permissions, and change-management workflow enforcement. Automated change approval and mapping deployments to incidents are documented only via the Jira Service Management integration. All evidence is high-level product-page claims, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit native approval gates per environment, explicit per-environment tracking of which commit or change is deployed, in-depth configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
